proposition: Hurufi sources say Ibn Turka's father Afẓal al-Dīn and brother Ṣadr al-Dīn attended Fażl Allāh's majlises in Isfahan to have their dreams interpreted; in the Khwābnāma account Fażl Allāh tells Ṣadr al-Dīn to drop a planned book harmonizing religion and philosophy and Afẓal al-Dīn dreams that God will build him a dome.

mediation.who: Naṣr Allāh Nāfajī, Khwābnāma; Sayyid Isḥāq, Khwābnāma (Hurufi sources)
mediation.where: Vatican MS Persian 17 ff. 32a-33a; Millet MS Ali Emiri Farsça 1042 f. 23a
mediation.note: partisan sources with an interest in showing notables attending Fażl Allāh; the Hurufi text calls Afẓal al-Dīn a member of Ṣadr al-Dīn's house where MK calls him Ṣāʾin al-Dīn's father
MK mentions it in a parenthesis and draws no conclusion
